name: encrypt
description: Pseudorandom AES-256 encryption designed to protect shellcode and arbitrary strings. C# and C/C++ compatible.

name: pe-sieve
description: Scans a given process. Recognizes and dumps a variety of potentially malicious implants (replaced/injected PEs, shellcodes, hooks, in-memory patches).

name: hollows_hunter

name: HatVenom
description: HatVenom is a HatSploit native powerful payload generation and shellcode injection tool that provides support for common platforms and architectures.
